ops.body: Verified 2026-08-29 against origin/main of both repos (daemonkit@040f095, synckit@f4553cc). synckit no longer imports daemonkit/service — that package doesn't exist in daemonkit at all (`git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main | grep '^service/'` → no match). synckit's daemon/service.go builds `[]launchd.Agent` directly (`func serviceAgents(manifests []manifest.Manifest) ([]launchd.Agent, error)`) and daemon/install.go applies each through daemonkit's own primitive: `daemon/install.go:41: return launchd.Apply(ctx, launchctl, agent)`, with `removeAgent` calling `launchd.Remove(ctx, launchctl, label)`. No ToolConfig/AgentSpec/LaunchdManager remain in code (only a historical CHANGELOG.md mention). synckit's go.mod pins `github.com/yasyf/daemonkit v0.23.0`. The migration landed in synckit commit b6919426 "chore: migrate to daemonkit v0.21.2 — Serve/Owned/durable, manifest isolation, label-derived sockets" (2026-08-03 08:58 UTC), about 1.5h after the prior 2026-08-03T07:19:17Z triage comment on this task — so the "still open, consumer:synckit" routing was accurate when written but has since been resolved. The low-level launchd plumbing now exists once, in daemonkit's launchd package, exactly as this task asked.
